follow_ups.title: GetItemById and UpdateItemV1 return application/json for 400s documented as application/problem+json
follow_ups.reason: BadRequest<ProblemDetails> is sent as application/json while their ProducesResponseType annotations declare application/problem+json, so clients and the OpenAPI document disagree.

follow_ups.title: Fix existing dotnet format whitespace and charset issues in CatalogApi.cs
follow_ups.reason: dotnet format --verify-no-changes fails on lines 91 and 98 and on the file's encoding, none of which this change touches, so CI format checks on this file will fail.

follow_ups.title: Map unique-key violations on catalog item insert to 409
follow_ups.reason: Two requests creating the same new id at the same moment can both pass the existence check, and the second still returns 500.
